caption: The video showcases a close, slightly high-angle view of a yellow electric wax warmer resting on a glossy white tabletop. Its silver-rimmed opening holds melted yellow wax, with a paler, partly solid chunk floating near the center. A yellow handle projects to the right from the pot's upper side, while a dark round dial sits on the front face. A small red indicator light glows at the lower front edge, marking the device as powered on throughout the visible excerpt. The translucent rim of a bowl is cut off at the bottom-left corner, and a bright rectangular reflection appears on the table at the upper right. Throughout the excerpt, the pot, handle, dial, bowl edge, and table reflection occupy the same positions. No object displacement or camera movement is detectable during this excerpt. The partially solid wax chunk keeps the same shape and position, so the visible portion shows a steady warming state rather than a new action.
relations: The glowing red indicator marks the warmer as powered, sustaining a steady warming state without new motion.
The partly solid wax chunk floats near the center of the melted pool, keeping its shape and position.
The pot, handle, dial, bowl edge, and table reflection remain fixed, showing no displacement or camera movement.
